description:
Runs the draft once with payload as the trigger data. Every node runs for real: WhatsApp messages, SMS, emails and calls go out and CRM records change. Ask the user before calling it, and use their own phone number or email in the payload.

It returns an `execution_id` at once. Poll `getWorkflowExecution` for the result.

(Tags: Workflows)

payload.description: The trigger data. Nodes read it as `{{ context.<trigger id>.<field> }}`. See `output_example` of the trigger node type for its shape.

name: testWorkflow
